R2_G3_P1_reachability.opportunity_metric_role: Diagnostic only; raw gap always retained; no retroactive success reclassification

R2_expert_tie_audit.scope: Common fine five-item counterfactual completion panels; identity here is panel identity, not equality of all scores or runtime state

prior_implementation_findings.R2_original_numeric_results: UNCHANGED; primary matching reproduced on all declared G3 P1 endpoint cases
prior_implementation_findings.R2_unknown_parent_match: Already rejects unknown/empty shared parents, no None==None credit observed
prior_implementation_findings.legacy_ndcg: Uses predicted rank and sorted ideal relevance correctly; legacy empty-target0 behavior preserved historically, new R3 returnsnull
prior_implementation_findings.new_R3_work: Explicit ID/length checks; exact k-cardinality reachability decomposition; distinguish set equivalence from rank equivalence

protocol.batch_alignment: Exact unique IDs and equal lengths; explicit error instead of zip truncation or incidental row order
protocol.candidate_universe: Frozen base-expert legal fine universe before any model soft priority/filter; exclude fixed visible A for all variants
protocol.capacity_floor: 1-min(k,|T|)/|T|, a capacity-only ideal with hypothetical exact coverage
protocol.duplicate_ids: Predictions deduplicated before k; fixed candidate duplicates rejected; duplicate target list entries collapse once
protocol.empty_targets: Unidentifiable: null gaps/NDCG/Recall; retained full-case coverage
protocol.external_relation_partial_credit: Separate diagnostic only; empty until independent relations are registered; training associations cannot grade themselves
protocol.matching: One-to-one maximum-weight bipartite assignment; k-cardinality assignment for fixed-universe M_star
protocol.missing_output: With target: gap1/Recall0/NDCG0, retained as failure
protocol.opportunity_gap: 1-M/M_star only if M_star>0; diagnostic, not a replacement denominator for primary raw_gap
protocol.rank_metric: Linear positive target relevance DCG by predicted rank / ideal sorted target DCG at same k; deduplicated predictions; all fixed targets retained in IDCG
protocol.threshold: Raw gap<=0.5 reachable iff M_star>=0.5*|T|; target_count>5 alone is insufficient
